title: Rogier J NDE 13063
content: The first 40 years of my life, I experienced the same dream/nightmare multiple times a month. It was always the same vision and memory. It took me 40 years to understand what I saw. Then the dream/nightmare never happened again. I think I truly understand what a saw, it was very real for me as I had a very strong eye-witness feeling at the time. Let me explain what I saw. Before I was born, I felt myself in my mother's uterus and it was a very comfortable place. My first memory was a warmth and a lovely feeling as an unborn. Somehow I understood that it was time for the natural childbirth. At that moment, I had an unpleasant feeling because I had a choice to make. I knew the birth channel was the way to go but it was blocked somehow. Later, I understood that the umbilical cord around my neck. The other choice was to give up and not be born. At that moment, I felt a strong need to be born. I knew the birth channel was located bottom right. Simultaneously, three creatures appeared on my left upper side. I did not recognize them, but could tell they were non-human and tall. I had only contact with the creature in the middle. I had a very pleasant feeling of comfort when it communicated with me. The communication was telepathic and ended with a kind and convincing head-nod. The vision disappeared and I was born, completely blue-colored due lack of oxygen. I tried to find a creature that comes close to what I experienced. The best I could find are the tall, supreme beings. They did not have human skin, but glowed with a high, orange-light energy. It was not scary at all and I felt like they were in control. After 40 years and speaking to my parents and wife, I feel it was a moment of choice concerning my new life or imminent death. I am still very happy that I was given the opportunity to life. I met and married the most beautiful, smart, and sweet wife you can imagine and she gave birth to our 4 sweet children. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: July 28th 1976 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Childbirth Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function). I was born with no sign of life due umbilical cord around my neck. With the help of the midwife, I was brought back to life. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I saw the non-human creatures; not before and not after that time only during At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? At the moment I had the choose and when I got the head-nod for making the right choice Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I saw the non-human creatures, not before and not after that time - only during the experience Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. no sound to hear. I had only an understanding (mind to mind) from the creature in the middle Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No. The birth channel to get born Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The three creatures were unearthly or at least not in our visible real life world. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt happy and had a warmth feeling of everything will be fine after the head-nod of that creature. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. I had to choose between birth or not to get born. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I did not know what my belief was at that moment Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. The 3 creatures as described before. They were tall, not human, and covered with a brownish cloak. The had a long face and their bodies consisted of orange-energy lightning-like body. I had only contact with the creature in the middle and that was a direct mind to mind contact. Very friendly creature that was looking after me. I had a very comfortable and lovely welcoming feeling. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes For me for sure, supreme beings exist. I know what I saw, what I experienced was very real to me. I never talked about it for the first 40 years of my life because I did not understand what happened and felt that no one would believe me. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes Sometimes I have a sense that we have to life our life the best possible manner to be the best version of ourselves. When succeeding one can grow and become some kind of higher creature, like an angel or something. It is hard to find the right words. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? No changes in my life After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Took me 40 years to understand what I experienced How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I saw non-human creatures who helped me making the right choice. That was very meaningful and significant for me. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes My wife listened but she is not really in to that. She knows I am a little different than normal. Once I luckily shared a dream and that dream (vision) came true the next day and I told her my dream the day before. So, she was very surprised what I described was really happening in front of her eyes. No other visions happened after that. My parents are the other people I told, they believe me and looked up on the internet about the creatures I described. No 1 to 1 result has been found. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I saw, felt and experienced it as other thing that a really happening. Not a dream or fantasy feeling. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It took me 40 years to understand what I was going through during that experience. After I accepted what happened, no more dreams/nightmares happened. It took about 40 years for this to happen. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No oeq5cdj_nde

It took me 40 years to understand what I saw. Then the dream/nightmare never happened again. I think I truly understand what a saw, it was very real for me as I had a very strong eye-witness feeling at the time. Let me explain what I saw. Before I was born, I felt myself in my mother's uterus and it was a very comfortable place. My first memory was a warmth and a lovely feeling as an unborn. Somehow I understood that it was time for the natural childbirth. At that moment, I had an unpleasant feeling because I had a choice to make. I knew the birth channel was the way to go but it was blocked somehow. Later, I understood that the umbilical cord around my neck. The other choice was to give up and not be born. At that moment, I felt a strong need to be born. I knew the birth channel was located bottom right. Simultaneously, three creatures appeared on my left upper side. I did not recognize them, but could tell they were non-human and tall. I had only contact with the creature in the middle. I had a very pleasant feeling of comfort when it communicated with me. The communication was telepathic and ended with a kind and convincing head-nod. The vision disappeared and I was born, completely blue-colored due lack of oxygen. I tried to find a creature that comes close to what I experienced. The best I could find are the tall, supreme beings. They did not have human skin, but glowed with a high, orange-light energy. It was not scary at all and I felt like they were in control. After 40 years and speaking to my parents and wife, I feel it was a moment of choice concerning my new life or imminent death. I am still very happy that I was given the opportunity to life. I met and married the most beautiful, smart, and sweet wife you can imagine and she gave birth to our 4 sweet children.
